title: Nociceptors report stimuli that could damage tissue
summary: Nociception is the sensation of potentially damaging stimuli, from mechanical, chemical, or thermal input past a threshold.
body: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology says pain is primarily a chemical sense of chemicals released by tissue damage, or of similar intense stimuli, through a nociceptor. Nociception is the sensation of potentially damaging stimuli. Mechanical, chemical, or thermal stimuli beyond a set threshold elicit painful sensations. The wording is the textbook's, CC BY 4.0, and it is not a treatment instruction.

sources.title: 14.1 Sensory Perception
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology, section 14.1, CC BY 4.0. No revision date was printed on the page. Supports nociception as the sensation of potentially damaging mechanical, chemical, or thermal stimuli.
